Premium plan changes can be made in the app under Profile > Plan; upgrades take effect immediately, while downgrades begin on the next billing date. For help, message support in the app anytime.

Individual ATMs may impose lower per-withdrawal caps, and withdrawals outside BrookLink may incur fees. Cash withdrawals aren’t covered by Cushion.
